prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one old photo booth strip texture for the horror game AFTER PLAY, fictional family indoor playground HAPPYLAND, Germany circa 1998. Create a flat front-on scan of a single tall narrow ivory photobooth print, four square monochrome snapshots stacked vertically, filling the image with no surrounding table, no perspective. Same adult employee wearing a worn rabbit mascot suit in every frame, oversized rabbit ears partly cropped by booth camera, cloth rabbit head held under arm so the tired adult face is visible. Friendly forced smile in the first two shots, looking off-camera in the third, an empty booth seat and motion-blurred edge of the departing costume in the fourth. A closed pleated curtain behind the seat. Real old low-flash analog booth photography, slightly underexposed, silver grain, uneven development, yellowed borders, hairline scratches and one dark water stain near the bottom. Restrained uncanny mood, grounded credible photography. All people are adults. No blood, no text, no logos, no watermark. Preserve four individually framed photographs and enough paper border. Aspect ratio approximately 1:3.

Edit the provided four-frame photobooth strip. Fix one costume continuity error: REMOVE the rabbit ears behind/on the HUMAN MAN'S HEAD completely in frames one, two and three. The man's head must be an ordinary bare adult human head with short dark hair, no headband, no animal ears, no protrusions; show plain pleated curtain behind his hair. ADD the pair of floppy rabbit ears to the REMOVED RABBIT MASCOT HEAD he holds in his arms, attached anatomically to the top of that separate rabbit head, kept below his shoulders where possible. This is one mascot costume with a removable head, so the man himself must have absolutely no rabbit ears. Preserve the same man's identity, expressions, furry torso costume, hands holding the mascot head, fourth empty-seat/departure frame, exact four-frame strip layout, old monochrome photo quality, aged paper borders and water stains. No other changes.
note: First draft was rejected for misplaced ears; only corrected v2 is shipped.
